name: coupnii
description: Custom demo/playground on niivue-react (medical image viewer) with my own MRI data. Core library is upstream, not original.

paragraphs: A customized playground built on top of niivue-react, an open-source React wrapper around Niivue (a WebGL medical image viewer). The core library (src/) is the upstream niivue-react package, unmodified; what's mine is the example app in examples/ — a custom viewer wired up to my own MRI/segmentation data instead of the library's demo dataset, used to explore rendering aligned and segmented brain volumes side by side.
This sits alongside coupdegrace, a from-scratch medical imaging upload/visualization tool — this repo is a smaller, separate exploration of Niivue's React bindings rather than part of that project.
